criticalBehavior.saleCooldown: Proposal rejects at activatedAt + 259199 s and succeeds at activatedAt + 259200 s; checked on real locally deployed artifact.
criticalBehavior.sharesDuringVoting: Existing orders cannot fill and ordinary transfers cannot move balances while an unexecuted active proposal has now < endsAt. Existing order cancellation unlocks shares without moving ownership or voting rights.
criticalBehavior.sharesAfterVotingExpired: If the pool remains Active and voting deadline expired without sale execution, share trading resumes; rejection of stale votes and proposal cooldown is separately tested.
criticalBehavior.sharesDuringWholeSaleListed: Existing order fills and ordinary transfers are rejected; orders remain cancellable.
criticalBehavior.sharesAfterClosedSale: Closed market fills reject; ordinary shares remain frozen permanently and old owner entitlement remains claimable. Closed market-fill case uses explicit terminal-state fixture; completed-sale permanence is also tested via real sale entry points.
criticalBehavior.purchaseAndSaleRaces: Same-block competing share fills and whole-machine purchases/sales conserve funds; losing buyers do not get shares or pay successful competing sale.
